title: It’s Never Too Early to Start Planning for the Next Two Solar Eclipses
summary: The next eclipse will occur in 2027 and has been dubbed “the eclipse of the century” due to its extraordinarily long duration, while the last one—set for 2028—will offer a chance to glimpse the “ring of fire” associated with an annular eclipse.
